survival_points_production_shape.name: survival_points_production_shape
survival_points_production_shape.value: "survival_points"."source" <> 'production' or ("survival_points"."points" is not null and not "survival_points"."provisional")

match_predictions_not_level.name: match_predictions_not_level
match_predictions_not_level.value: "match_predictions"."home" is null or "match_predictions"."away" is null or "match_predictions"."home" <> "match_predictions"."away"

match_predictions_fill_in_scored.name: match_predictions_fill_in_scored
match_predictions_fill_in_scored.value: "match_predictions"."origin" = 'real' or ("match_predictions"."home" is not null and "match_predictions"."away" is not null)

games_winner_needs_result.name: games_winner_needs_result
games_winner_needs_result.value: "games"."recorded_winner_id" is null or "games"."home_score" is not null
